name: Windows synthetic verification
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run boundary:check
      - run: npm run release:check
      - run: npm run ui:check
      - name: Browser environment
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Get-Item "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty VersionInfo | Select-Object ProductVersion, FileVersion
      - run: npm run test:ui
        env:
          DEBUG: pw:browser
      - run: npm run source:export

# Local unified installation 1.15.0-local.1

Use the parent workspace launchers and existing private runtime. Preserve identity, memories, history, permissions, budgets and original daily consent. Public general-installation guides describe independent fresh installs; do not create a second local installation to replace existing individuals. No credentials or staging bindings are deployed.

# Kinseed contributor instructions

Use synthetic individuals and separate private runtime data. Never change existing identities, birth records, memories, histories, permissions or life authorizations for a test. Do not modify original governance or declare Freeze.

The project uses AI-executed self-acceptance with honest disclosure of unperformed independent human, native-language and second-physical-machine checks. Keep failed/blocked historical results and source hashes; do not repair model answers or memories in the harness. See docs/AI_ACCEPTANCE_POLICY.md, ACCEPTANCE_SCOPE.md and OPEN_SOURCE_ENGINEERING_PLAN.md (revision7).

Run npm test, npm run ui:check, npm run test:ui and npm run release:check. Hosted CI/default tests use no real model accounts. Provider tests are explicit opt-in and may consume capacity. Preserve Chromium sandboxing and production safety boundaries.

Keep .private, local configuration, credentials, identities, memory, work, raw histories and private evidence out of commits and source exports. Export with scripts/export-source.mjs; package-lock and third-party notices must be included. Raw logs and screenshots are not public acceptance reports. Public artifacts must use synthetic content and be reviewed.

GitHub publication and capability changes require explicit Owner authorization; release governance permission is not life authorization. Use a separate clean source repository, never a private operational project or its Git history. Update guides, supported combinations, acceptance records and release notes with each change. Do not fabricate active support/security channels or untested model qualification.

# Kinseed

Current source version: **1.14.0-preview.1**. General installation now includes manual/daily reports and archive visibility. Start with [the complete installation guide](docs/PUBLIC_INSTALL_1_14.md), [capability matrix](docs/PUBLIC_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md), and [upgrade recovery](docs/UPGRADE_RECOVERY.md). The source update passed [hosted Windows verification](https://github.com/AlexZhuang12/Kinseed/actions/runs/40239268158). No new tag or Release is implied.

Windows preview **1.13.0-preview.1**. An Owner-controlled environment for individual identity, memory, daily activity and scoped tools, using Codex or a local-model adapter.

Use the [English guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.en.md), [繁體中文](docs/USER_GUIDE.zh-Hant.md), [简体中文](docs/USER_GUIDE.zh-Hans.md) or [日本語](docs/USER_GUIDE.ja.md). On Windows with Node 24.19.x, run the included first-setup CMD after cloning. It installs locked dependencies with install scripts disabled, helps select a brain and prepare tools, and starts your own empty private runtime. Models and logins are yours. No private individual data is included.

See [version notes](docs/RELEASE_1_14_0_PREVIEW.md), [daily consent and recovery](docs/LIFE_AUTHORITY_AND_RECOVERY.md), [acceptance policy](docs/AI_ACCEPTANCE_POLICY.md), [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and [security reporting](SECURITY.md). This is a preview. Model adapters do not imply full-life qualification of every model.

Apache-2.0 applies to original code; third-party notices remain applicable.

## Hedra and document tools

Opt-in image/video/music generation with scoped credits, reservation and recovery; generated document readback and saved PDF page viewing. Bring your own accounts; no credentials or individuals are shipped. See [Hedra operation](docs/HEDRA_FOUNDATION.md), [current feature limits](docs/RELEASE_1_13_0_PREVIEW.md) and [proposed next stages](docs/HEDRA_WORKFLOW_ITERATION_PLAN.md).

## Current tools and console

Guided pink interface, scoped tool permissions, Hedra model inspection and saved media, local film composition, PDF layout and queued page previews, and opt-in local Whisper dialogue transcription. See [current version and acceptance scope](docs/RELEASE_1_13_0_PREVIEW.md), [console journey](docs/OWNER_CONSOLE_JOURNEY.md) and [Whisper setup](docs/WHISPER_SERVICE.md). No model weights, account credentials or existing individuals are included. Permissions remain off for a new installation; generating paid media and sending email require the configured approval flow. Speech transcription is not emotional, musical or artistic listening evaluation.

## Consultation and report reliability

Consultations return a durable job ID for later readback without cancelling future daily consent on a settled failure. Report sources now handle exact multiline quotations, preserve self-report attribution, and permit one model revision after an unsupported-content review, retaining independent checks. The general installation now includes manual and scheduled reports, using its own configured brain, time zone and private data. See [release scope](docs/RELEASE_1_13_0_PREVIEW.md), [second-computer installation](docs/SECOND_COMPUTER.zh-Hant.md) and [AI acceptance](docs/acceptance/PUBLIC_1_13_0.md).

# Windows 開發架構與資料保護

開發入口 `scripts/development.mjs` 使用目前V1.2核心及控制台，但獨立管理啟動、設定與資料。它不調用歷史遷移、原生條件匯入、Codex預檢、報告啟動或既有單例埠。

## 啟動順序

讀取工作目錄標記 → 驗證設定 → 檢查路徑與連結 → 核對私人資料標記 → 啟動本機空平台 → 將Owner連線存入私人資料區。已有未知內容的資料夾不接管，同一資料庫已有管理程序時拒絕第二次啟動。

模型執行器預設停用；明確啟用第2版Codex設定並通過預檢後，生活與獨立請教共用src/brain接口，工具仍經原MCP門核對。模型接入不改任何個體的工具權限、身份或生活授權。報告用途也使用同一契約，但不啟用報告排程。

## 設定與相容性

產品版本目前沿用1.2.0，平台與個體SQLite格式仍為12；設定支援第1版停用、第2版Codex與第3版本地接頭，私人資料標記維持第1版。容量仍為記憶60條、計畫20條、提交總量20,000字元，不使用舊20／10程式還原擴充資料。

`source-baseline.json`記錄程式來源雜湊。獨立入口、空白初始化、報告導航與前端組裝是本階段的變更；其餘生活核心沿用既有來源。檔案允許清單控制套件候選內容，私人資料另受忽略規則保護，但公開發布仍需完整審查。

## 升級與回退

本版沒有遷移正式資料，也沒有部署至既有控制器。停止本開發版即可停止使用；刪除程式前應另行保留 `.private`及本地設定，不能用測試資料覆蓋其他環境。

未來正式升級必須先確認工作收尾，使用一致性備份，檢查身份、出生、原始歷史鏈與資料格式，再由Owner決定恢復。複製正在寫入的SQLite主檔不等同於一致性備份。資料搬移只能有一個活動控制器，不能讓同一個體在兩處同時生活。

## 大腦接口與下一階段

模型執行器已統一開始、工具觀察、完成、取消、逾時、未知結果與用量，詳見BRAIN_INTERFACE.md。Codex接頭內部仍由CLI管理工具往返；Kinseed負責租約、授權與交易，不能用模型文字當成工具成功或取消確認。本地接頭的對話與工具循環已完成合成驗證，真實模型仍待選定與實測，見LOCAL_BRAIN_PHASE_03.md。Codex委派作為手腳屬於另外的工具能力，尚未接入，不與本階段Codex作為大腦混淆。

## 受控委派更新

受控工具執行者已在本候選接入，見 CODEX_TOOL_INTERFACE.md。父大腦經原生活MCP呼叫delegate_codex；子Codex只取得另一個獨立短效代理，不取得父cycle能力、身份、記憶或Owner控制。原作品工具仍核對同一個體的授權與租約；未知工具或交易收尾會保留原worker。上節「尚未接入」為此前階段語境。

# 受控 Codex／MCP 工具接口（獨立 Windows 候選）

此接口讓任何符合大腦契約的接頭，透過 `delegate_codex` 委派一件作品工作。Codex作為另外的工具執行者，不接替個體身份，也不提交個體記憶。不是官方舊版 Codex MCP server；本版沿用已驗證 CLI 0.164.0-alpha.11.1（亦保留已驗證的0.163.0-alpha.10.2），執行固定的 Kinseed MCP 代理。

## Owner 操作

1. 使用本候選 README 的入口；不要使用其他環境的資料或連線。預設大腦仍停用。
2. 管理合成個體 → 工具權限 → 勾選「委派Codex處理作品工作」→ 保存。未保存不生效，原設定未開放時一律拒絕。
3. 若要編輯或隔離執行，同時開放原本的作品編輯／隔離JavaScript權限。委派權限不能替代它們。
4. 正常設定並明確授權合成個體生活；新增權限不會批准、出生、解除停止或恢復生活。
5. 已產生的作品與執行成果仍在「工具工作與成品 → 作品與執行」查看。完整委派依據為自己的 B：`delegate.intent`／`delegate.result`／`delegate.failed`；私人工作區內 `delegations/<job>/events.jsonl` 保存程序與工具收據。

本次未在其他環境部署或增權；不能因此直接給既有個體打開。

## 工具契約

`delegate_codex({request_id,instruction,operations,inputs})`：instruction最多3000字元；operations可選read／edit／execute，execute須同時選edit；inputs最多5個自己的作品ID。沒有路徑、模型、MCP地址、身份、shell或任意命令欄位。

執行者只取得選入的作品及本次新增作品，讀取分頁仍最多6000字元。工具清單只包含work_read，按選項加入work_save／run_javascript；沒有作品總清單、來源匯入、身份、記憶、Owner傳訊、外網、再次委派或Owner管理接口。即使猜到其他作品ID也拒絕。執行仍為既有QuickJS／WASM，不是Node、主機shell或套件安裝。

父個體有效租約、身份世代、控制版本、時間、停止、權限及16次工具上限仍是最後權威。子工具也消耗該輪工具次數。委派最多60秒且受父輪與生活截止約束；每輪最多一次，另占個體與平台各一次模型額度，失敗不退回、不默默重送。同請求同內容讀回既有收據，不啟動第二次；異內容及另一委派拒絕。寫入請求以本次工作命名空間綁定，避免與其他工作碰撞。

## 隔離、收尾與結果

父大腦的cycle能力不傳入子Codex；子程序只有短效獨立代理能力，沒有Owner能力。CLI沿原MXC、never、禁shell／網路／使用者工具設定，不降低沙箱換取成功。只傳工作指示及明確選入作品，不自動帶身份、記憶或Owner對話。沿原外傳檢查拒絕憑證、本機路徑及已知Owner私人內容；這不是能辨識所有轉述或編碼的完整資料外洩防護。

停止／撤權／到期先撤銷代理，再取消自己的CLI；核對CLI close、已觀察代理PID不再存在及實際工具收尾，才結算。PID只用於保守存活核對，不用PID猜測或停止別人的程序。結果未知、紀錄交易失敗或派送後例外會保留worker／lease並阻擋重送；不提供無證據的「強制清空」恢復按鈕。確認本機程序退出不代表遠端供應商取消或未計費。

`transport_completed`／`status=completed`只代表模型工作完整回覆；`operations_status`另外區分沒有執行、工具失敗或完成。`task_verified=false`、`narrative_verified=false`：文章與任務目標沒有被系統自動認證。請看receipts及原始執行結果；程式拋錯可在模型正常回報的情況下呈現operations_status=failed。作品成功後即保留，後續失敗不刪作品；記憶仍只有父大腦自己的commit_cycle可以原子更新。

## 相容與回退

未增加依賴或DB格式遷移。舊權限缺codex視為false；沒有修改本地模型提示／流程或新增模型特例。已知限制：只驗證此Windows／CLI／固定模型組合；尚無任意第三方MCP安裝或一般主機工具。Qwen完整生活資格仍未通過，不因這個接口而改為通過。

回退先停止本候選並確認工作退出，保存.private與設定。移除delegate_codex註冊、platform分流、可選權限及UI條目即可停用；保留原有作品、收據及B，不用舊資料庫覆蓋歷史，不復活過期授權。既有設定若保留codex欄位，舊permissionSettings會忽略；不要由舊版保存權限後假定此能力仍開放。正式環境未更新，不需要正式回退。

官方參考：[非互動CLI](https://developers.openai.com/codex/noninteractive)、[MCP工具接入](https://developers.openai.com/codex/mcp)。具體旗標以本專案固定CLI與實際證據為準，不假定所有新版相容。

容量不足補充：provider_failure.kind依真實CLI事件分類，顯示繁中提示；模型在部分作品保存後中斷時，operations_status=partial。保留已保存作品與實際用量，不盲目重送整份工作。最後真實重驗曾遇到此情況，原失敗保留，沒有冒稱該案任務成功。

# Film candidate AI acceptance

Version **1.9.0-film-preview.1**. Independent synthetic Windows installation. No existing individual, shared service, formal controller or private work was used for testing. This is not a public release.

## Executed evidence

- Full program regression: **807 passed, 0 failed**. Four-language browser regression: **31 scripts / 692 checks passed**. Clean-install, backup and restart: **13 checks passed**. Independent entry: **8 checks passed**. Real-model three-round integration: **15 checks passed**. The UI suite covers isolated playback, actual video advancement, download hashes, separate permission drafts, cross-individual separation and no automatic life.
- Synthetic clips and pure tone are created by the isolated FFmpeg/WASM engine, then trimmed, concatenated, mixed, captioned, decoded and sampled. Changing captions reuses unchanged clip steps and retains both project versions. Frame review, waveform and audio-segment behavior are tested separately.
- A real Codex brain completed **three rounds** through the real controlled MCP interface: authored a timeline/captions, submitted a local render, continued from its own memory, requested a timed frame, actually received the image, and authored review and memory. The harness did not supply its captions, judgments or memories. Separate fixed scripted tests are explicitly identified as harness evidence, not model creativity.
- The model's visual review sampled 1200 ms. It did not claim to watch the whole moving film or hear the audio. Engineering visual QA additionally inspects frames across the cut. Browser and decode checks are separate from semantic understanding.
- Current Hedra speech/effects schemas and a queried shared-library voice search were verified through the actual candidate read-only connection; reported available credits were unchanged before and after that check; private account balances are excluded from this public summary. No voice cloning, private voice library listing, billing-mode change or paid generation occurred.
- Failures cover source hashes, foreign IDs, schema/parameter injection, storage/size limits, active cancellation, permission withdrawal, restart, finite explicit retry, unknown paid submission and preserved daily authority. Cold backups reject unknown formats, corrupted ledgers and live senders; no old database restore command is introduced.
- Source/dependency integrity and clean-install/backup/start-stop checks are recorded separately. No third-party human, native-language or second physical Windows acceptance is claimed.

## Diagnoses retained, not hidden

Early loader asset addressing failed and was corrected without opening network access. Initial tests assumed a daily-state row existed in a fixture that had not enabled daily life; the fixture was corrected through the real Owner daily-authorization path. An existing permission test was updated to explicitly leave the new media flag off, preserving its original assertions.

Stricter full-decode testing exposed a real FFmpeg/WASM ordering defect: running ffprobe before FFmpeg in the same module could yield missing decode/volume evidence. The order was fixed, probe is constrained to the final step, and QC now requires a completion footer plus volume measurements when audio exists. Metadata success alone is not a technical acceptance pass. Earlier failed logs remain retained.

A clean installation also exposed the old maintenance inspector rejecting the Hedra ledger. A dedicated read-only schema/history/owner/outbox checker was added; unknown schemas and active owners still fail closed. Installation and backup are rerun after this correction.

## Limits and next gates

Real paid speech/effect/reference/video generation has **not** been validated in this iteration. The synthetic integration is not a claim about external model quality or refunds. Current audio semantic understanding remains unsupported; actual audio can be played by Owner, and technical statistics/waveforms do not establish listening. Larger/longer projects, professional quality and lip sync are outside this qualified scope.

Formal deployment, new formal permissions, a concrete paid test and GitHub publication require separate Owner decisions. GPL FFmpeg/core retains its terms; corresponding-source and nested-codec distribution obligations must be reviewed before public redistribution. See FILM_WORKFLOW.md.

# Independent film workflow — 1.9.0-film-preview.1

This is an independent Windows candidate. It does not deploy to an existing controller or grant permissions to existing individuals. Use this copy's own development entry. Formal private data and shared chat/model services are excluded.

## Six delivered engineering stages

1. Own-result reference continuity: integrates the earlier P3 candidate. Only the individual's own saved Hedra PNG/JPEG original assets can be referenced. Owner material upload, whole-account library access, URLs and host paths are excluded. A separate reference permission is required; original job/asset binding is checked before estimate and dispatch.
2. Inspection: typed `media_job` operations inspect actual streams, extract timed frames, extract WAV audio segments, draw waveforms and decode the full bounded media for technical QC. Images can reach a verified vision-capable brain through `media_image_view`; no raw video/audio model input is claimed.
3. Sound: separate `speech` and `sound_effects` permissions alongside existing music. `hedra_voices` requires a query and searches the shared library; private cloned-voice listing and cloning/conversion tools are not exposed. Speech uses named voice/language/speed; effects use bounded duration/loop/prompt influence. Same held/spent budget and unknown-submission safeguards apply. Real generation requires explicit test approval.
4. Editing: `media_timeline_save` stores the individual's own clip decisions and text; `media_job(render)` normalizes/trims clips, retains or mutes original audio, concatenates, mixes additional tracks with gain/fades and limiting, burns in explicit captions with bounded font size, band height and top/bottom placement, and produces H.264/AAC MP4.
5. Versioned project: immutable timelines bind exact source versions and SHA values. Each clip step is saved atomically. Changing captions can reuse unchanged clip recipes. Completed steps and originals are retained; no external generation is replayed. `media_retry` permits at most two explicit local continuations; queued/paused jobs require current life and permission. A restarted running step is interrupted, not silently replayed. Owner can cancel pending jobs.
6. Acceptance: full decode, streams/duration, black segments, silence events and volume are technical evidence. Frame-based review requires actual provided frames from the specified source. Individual review text and memory must be authored by the model; fixed harness assertions are identified separately. A technical pass does not establish artistic quality, lip sync or semantic listening.

## Bounds and permissions

Local `media` permission defaults off and is distinct from Hedra generation permissions. Frame/waveform delivery also requires vision. Speech/effects/reference flags default off; legacy settings preserve existing explicit flags rather than granting new ones. No new permission creates life authority, changes an individual's identity or increases a budget.

First supported workspace: at most 30 seconds, 1280×720, 8 clips, 8 added audio tracks and 40 captions. Each file is at most 8 MB; all historical hub objects retain the existing 20 MB aggregate limit. Total input to one WASM invocation is at most 12 MB. Larger or more complex projects may be rejected. Pending intermediate files count toward storage. No automatic deletion, quota increase or professional-quality guarantee is offered.

The local engine is the pinned, single-thread `@ffmpeg/core@0.12.10` WebAssembly program. Assets are SHA-checked. It runs inside Chromium's existing sandbox and a kill-on-close 768 MiB Windows process-tree Job. Only immutable engine assets can load; external requests, WebSockets and arbitrary host files are unavailable. No host FFmpeg executable, desktop control or model-supplied shell/filter command is exposed. One heavyweight local conversion runs at a time in this controller. A bounded step has a 20-second conversion ceiling; original life authorization is checked again before save. Closing/stop aborts only this controller's jobs and waits for settlement.

Unexpected recording failure blocks only this media subsystem and appears as `last_error`; it does not cancel daily life. Storage cannot be silently reclaimed from immutable history. Never handle an unknown paid submission as a safe local retry.

## Honest interpretation limits

Current Codex vision integration can receive extracted PNG frames. Sampling frames cannot establish every intermediate motion in a video. The current brain adapter has **no verified audio semantic-input path**: it can receive technical measurements and a waveform, while Owner can play actual files and segments. The system must not say it has listened to dialogue or judged musical emotion from those measurements. `media_review.audio_review` is limited to `not_reviewed` / `owner_needed`.

FFmpeg core's bundled ffprobe writes the requested JSON but may return -1. Inspection accepts only a successfully written, parsed, validated stream JSON; ordinary rendering still requires zero exit status and actual output bytes. FFmpeg decode must precede ffprobe in a shared invocation; QC additionally requires the completed decode footer and, where audio exists, real volume statistics. A successful metadata read is not a full decode pass. Missing/invalid probe output is a failure. The returned technical report separates warnings (black/silent segments, missing audio or stream-duration mismatch) from artistic choices; it does not automatically reject an intentional dark or silent scene. This is a documented core behavior, not permission to ignore arbitrary process failures.

## User flow

Owner: tools and materials → select individual → tool permissions → explicitly enable local media if desired. Hedra speech/effects/reference are separately saved in Hedra settings. Film workspace shows projects, local job progress/errors, saved media, isolated playback/download and the individual's review. Viewing never starts life or generation. Unsaved permissions remain drafts. Source media and versions remain visible.

Individual: list own media → inspect → choose sources → save timeline → enqueue render → continue other work or wait → inspect job status → request frames/audio segments/QC → receive frames → author review → save a changed timeline if needed → render and recheck. Job IDs and completed outputs are included compactly in subsequent context. The model chooses creative content; the system supplies operations and evidence.

## Dependencies and release boundary

`npm ci --ignore-scripts` obtains the pinned engine through the npm lockfile. New dependency has GPL-2.0-or-later terms, separate from original Kinseed Apache-2.0 sources. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and third-party/ffmpeg-GPLv2.txt. No engine binary is embedded in the clean source ZIP. GPL terms and nested codec/source obligations must be reviewed before a future public/binary release; no legal certification or reproducible upstream-build proof is claimed.

No voice cloning, speech conversion, arbitrary Owner upload, desktop editor automation, new paid service, automatic publishing, formal deployment or new formal permission is part of this candidate. Real paid media generation, formal rollout and future public release are separate approval points.

# 第一次安裝與選擇大腦（Windows預覽版）

## 最短操作路線

1. 取得完整來源副本並解壓縮。最外層應看到README、package.json、**package-lock.json**及「首次設定.cmd」。請使用 GitHub 的乾淨來源，不要把含私人資料的原工程根目錄當成公開來源。
2. 安裝含npm的Node.js **24.19以上、25以下**。目前只驗證Windows；Node.js下載：[官方網站](https://nodejs.org/)。
3. 雙擊「首次設定.cmd」，保留命令視窗。瀏覽器會開啟自己的本機設定頁；若沒有自動開啟，使用命令視窗顯示的本次連結。也可在來源目錄執行 `npm run setup`；設定程式本身不需要先安裝專案依賴。
4. 依序完成下方五步。設定只作用於這份副本，不複製其他環境的個體資料。

## 五個步驟

| 步驟 | 要做什麼 | 完成後會發生什麼 |
|---|---|---|
| 1．檢查與安裝 | 查看Node與套件狀態，按「安裝程式需要的套件」 | 依鎖定版本安裝到這份副本的node_modules。不使用管理員、不執行套件安裝腳本、不安裝模型。 |
| 2．選擇大腦 | 選「先不接」、自己的Codex，或本機Ollama模型 | 只檢查接頭。選本地時需按檢查才連線；清單只讀已有模型，不下載、載入或推理。 |
| 3．準備工具 | 決定是否準備Codex受控作品工具接頭 | MCP自動接好，不須輸入JSON或通訊埠；仍未開放任何個體的工具權限。 |
| 4．確認保存 | 看白話摘要，確認大腦、工具及資料位置後保存 | 既有設定先備份。保存不建立身份、不批准、不出生、不解除停止、不恢復生活。 |
| 5．開啟控制台 | 按啟動，再按進入控制台 | 新副本使用空資料；再次啟動保留本副本的資料，依已保存的每日授權核對排程；Owner明確停止不自行恢復。 |

上一步及重新整理會保留本瀏覽器分頁的選擇。關閉後再次執行時可讀取已保存設定；未保存選擇不是正式設定。設定已被另一個視窗修改時會拒絕覆蓋，請按「重新讀取已保存設定」後重新核對。網路斷線後重按相同保存，若已保存同一份內容，不會重複覆寫。

## 選擇Codex

目前支援已驗證的CLI **0.164.0-alpha.11.1（亦保留已驗證的0.163.0-alpha.10.2）**及GPT-6.1-Sol／low組合。可以使用已有支援版本，或按導引的「安裝指定版本」裝到這份副本的.private/codex-cli，不更新全域或Desktop的程式。安裝需要網路與磁碟空間，只從公開npm登錄取得固定版本；不自動接受其他版本。

按「檢查版本與登入」只執行版本／登入狀態檢查，不呼叫模型。如果未登入，按開啟登入視窗，**自行在Codex官方登入流程完成驗證**；導引不收密碼、權杖或複製帳號檔案。登入狀態仍由Codex依這個Windows使用者的正常登入位置管理，不是另外建立一套Kinseed帳號；本次工程驗收沒有替Owner登入或切換帳號。

官方參考：[CLI安裝](https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli)、[登入](https://developers.openai.com/codex/auth)。公開登錄已確認上述版本存在，但即時下載與帳號模型容量不能保證永遠可用。預檢通過不表示任何模型任務都成功或不會容量不足。

## 選擇本地模型

先自行準備Ollama及模型，保持服務開啟，再輸入本機服務位址。只接受127.0.0.1 HTTP，不接受外部服務、帳密、代理或正式控制器埠。按檢查列出模型，選擇一個已有模型，再繼續。服務清單沒有模型時，先自行安裝模型再重查；導引不會替你下載。

進階設定可選文字容量、回答預留及工具互動格式。預設逐次選一個工具；沿既有通用契約，不為某一模型補答案或記憶。模型需提供文字與工具能力及足夠上下文；檢查失敗會顯示原因。檢查只讀metadata，不代表完整生活能力或速度已通過實測。原Qwen小模型的生活資格仍未通過；不能因為選單可選就宣稱合格。

## Codex／MCP工具與個體權限

「大腦」負責思考與選擇；「Codex工具接頭」負責受委派的作品工作，可以分開選。即使選本地大腦，也可準備Codex工具，但工作內容會送給Codex並使用帳號額度。每輪最多一次委派，另占個體與平台一次模型嘗試。

Kinseed MCP使用程式自己的設定與短效能力，不改使用者全域MCP設定。此版只支援Kinseed已有的受控工具，尚無任意第三方MCP安裝入口。詳細範圍見[工具接口指南](CODEX_TOOL_INTERFACE.md)。

完成初次設定後，仍須到「管理個體→工具權限」明確選擇要給哪個個體開放；編輯及隔離執行亦需原權限。準備接頭不會代替Owner批准身份或首次出生。

## 重新開啟、停止與改設定

- 設定頁重新整理後，可用「開啟已在執行的控制台」找回同一份副本的連線。
- 使用設定頁的停止按鈕，或這份副本的「停止開發控制台.cmd」。停止只作用於已驗證屬於本副本的控制台；不會去停止其他環境。
- 要換大腦或安裝套件，先停止這份控制台，再重新執行首次設定。執行中不切換設定。保存不恢復生活。
- 私人資料在.private，自己的設定在config/development.local.json；舊設定備份在.private/setup-backups。不要分享.private、私人設定、日誌、模型輸出或連線網址。

若連線檔存在但服務沒有確認關閉，導引會拒絕安裝／覆寫，請先用本副本停止入口確認。不要為了通過檢查任意刪除DB、未知工作或舊授權；真正異常退出後需核對連線及工作收尾，這個安裝導引不提供無證據清空功能。

## 原始碼包、限制與回退

這是獨立Windows預覽環境，已採Apache-2.0、尚未發布GitHub；不宣稱在第二台實體電腦驗收，也不直接套用到既有正式資料。不要將候選整目錄覆蓋其他服務。

建立乾淨來源包時執行 `node scripts/export-source.mjs`；輸出在本副本的.private/exports。允許清單包含package-lock.json及必要標記，不含私人設定或資料。**npm pack會刻意省略package-lock.json，不能直接拿其清單當作此工具的完整來源安裝包。**

要回退設定，先停妥本副本，保存目前config/development.local.json，再將本次備份的設定放回該檔。既有資料、作品、出生及歷史不回退；不以舊DB覆蓋新生活史、不恢復舊生活授權。若只想暫時停用，在導引選「先不接大腦」及關閉Codex工具後保存即可；私人資料保留。

大型CLI安裝會顯示實際下載量並保留已收到的片段。只有完整程式包通過官方SHA-512校驗後，才會離線安裝並核對執行檔版本；片段或檔案長度不代表完成。每次下載有10分鐘上限，中斷後可再按安裝繼續，不需要整包重抓。這是程式下載，不是模型下載。

要換瀏覽器，請用設定頁的「複製可在其他瀏覽器開啟的設定連結」或「複製控制台連結」，不要只複製位址列。完整連結含本次操作驗證，請勿分享給他人。瀏覽器不允許複製時，可從命令視窗取得完整設定連結。


控制台內可隨時開啟「操作導引」。完整接續流程見 [Owner快速指南](OWNER_QUICK_GUIDE.md)。

# P3: reuse an individual's own saved Hedra images

Independent candidate version 1.8.0-hedra-preview.1. P0–P2 remain supported. This document supersedes their text-only statement only for the own-result scope below. Nothing in this document grants permissions or authorizes paid generation.

## Scope

`hedra_references` lists only the current individual's saved `hedra-media` PNG/JPEG objects. `hedra_quote.references` accepts one to four `{source_id, role}` entries: `reference_image` for images; `reference_image`, `start_image` or `end_image` for video if the chosen model supports that input. Existing explicit duration, model schema, estimate, live balance, Owner reserve, cumulative and single-item limits still apply. No reference inputs for music.

An original completed job must belong to this individual and the selected workspace. The saved bytes must match their hash. The original provider asset is reused; there is no upload route, private account-wide library listing, arbitrary URL, filesystem path, Owner material or another individual's source. A local saved image alone does not prove that the provider still retains the original asset.

## Explicit permission

The new `reference_images` setting defaults false for old and new individuals. Image/video permission alone does not grant it. Owner must save it separately in the Hedra panel, alongside the existing media rights and budgets. Old clients which omit the new field preserve its actual value. Drafts, server-saved state and version conflicts remain distinct. `hedra_references` reports whether the new permission is enabled.

## Safety and failure handling

Quotes bind the exact source object/version/hash, own original job, original asset and workspace. Validate model-supported asset input, item count, actual dimensions, aspect ratio and file size. Required URL-only image inputs are not advertised as compatible. There is no automatic resize, substitute source, prompt completion or replacement generation.

Recheck source and permission when submitting, dequeuing and just before the paid call. Check original remote job and asset availability. Expiry, removal, incompatible dimensions or revoked rights block that new job and release its unsubmitted hold. Earlier charges, source media and life authorization remain intact. An ambiguous paid submission retains its hold and original intent for investigation; duplicate submission cannot create another attempt. Restart preserves this state. This prevents local replay; it cannot promise provider exactly-once execution or refunds.

## Acceptance boundary

AI-executed tests use synthetic individuals and a synthetic Hedra transport for reference quotes, generation attempts, expiry, revocation, cross-individual isolation, schema constraints, ambiguous submission and restart. Actual local HTTP/MCP paths and four-language Chrome UI are exercised. Public model specifications were inspected read-only, without generating or uploading. No actual paid reference image/video generation has been verified. No human/native-language/second-physical-Windows acceptance is claimed.

## Deferred

Explicit Owner material consent and upload transport, other media input formats, speech/effects, editing workflows and complete paid short-film acceptance are later stages. Broad P3 is not complete: this candidate implements the own-result reference subset only. Keep this copy independent and stop it through its own entry; rollback means closing this candidate and preserving its private ledger, not overwriting any formal database.

# AI-executed P3 own-reference acceptance

Candidate: 1.8.0-hedra-preview.1. Windows, Node 24.19.0, headless Chrome with sandbox enabled. Independent synthetic runtime; no formal rollout. Scope: own saved Hedra PNG/JPEG only. See HEDRA_OWN_REFERENCE_P3.md.

| Validation | Final result |
|---|---|
| Complete Node regression | 745 passed, 0 failed |
| Reference-specific tests | 17 passed; included in 745 |
| Complete four-language UI | 604 checks in 27 scripts passed |
| New reference UI | 15 per language; included in 604 |
| Translation/build consistency | 1979 messages; English/Japanese missing 0 |
| Independent entry | Own start/status/shutdown; empty/stopped, inference off, session removed |
| Source review | Boundary, pattern/dependency review and manifest/ZIP checks passed |

Tests cover explicit permission and default-off, drafts versus grants, exact own-source bindings, cross-individual refusal, source version changes, expired assets, dimensions and URL-only incompatibility, queued/final-read revocation, duplicate submission, ambiguous submission with retained hold, restart without replay, and actual local HTTP/MCP paths. The initial UI run read the preview frame before navigation completed. The harness now waits for actual frame content instead of a fixed short delay. Public provider model schemas were inspected read-only. Reference generation, expiry and disconnect tests use a synthetic provider. No provider exactly-once, refund, professional media quality or absence-of-all-vulnerabilities guarantee is made. Private account values, individual data and raw private logs must not be published.

## Resource compatibility revalidation

The common tool-resource correction was subsequently applied to this independent candidate: separate image/structured-data/model-text budgets, matching 4 MiB tool request envelopes, metadata-only paginated inventories, and tool-scoped resource failure handling. Complete Node revalidation passed 765 tests (including the 20 new shared tests and the existing 17 reference tests). The 604-check full UI run above belongs to the earlier P3 delivery; this correction separately reruns the 60 reference UI checks, while the matching common runtime's 544-check four-language regression is recorded in its own release evidence. # Hedra workflow P0–P2 candidate

Version: 1.7.0-hedra-preview.1. Independent candidate only. This is not a formal deployment or a permission grant.

## Supported tools

| Official MCP capability | Kinseed support in this candidate |
|---|---|
| list_models, get_model | `hedra_models`, `hedra_model`: public catalog and bounded input specifications. A catalog entry is not a promise of adapter compatibility. `unsupported_required`, `input_compatible`, `generation_tool`, and `estimate_required` describe the boundary. |
| estimate | Existing `hedra_quote`. It does not generate; an actual successful quote remains necessary. |
| generate_image, generate_video, generate_music | Existing durable submission/credit ledger. Text inputs only; image/video aspect and resolution, video/music explicit duration, selected quality. Existing permissions and limits still apply. |
| get_generations | Only jobs already bound to this individual's ledger. Remote success, charge settlement and local saving are separate facts. |
| Original output download | `hedra_save`: no arbitrary URL or remote job ID supplied by a model. Re-resolve the original asset URL before each explicit attempt. Never regenerate to repair a failed download. |
| Saved image to model | `hedra_view`: own PNG/JPEG, at most 200 KB, existing vision permission and supported Codex image input. Providing bytes is not proof of understanding. |
| Saved media to Owner | Authenticated local download; image, video and music previews in an opaque sandbox with no scripts, forms, parent access or remote resources. |
| generate_speech, generate_sound_effects, list_voices | Not included. The existing audio permission means music only; a public audio catalog may contain unsupported speech/effects models. |
| prepare_upload, upload_file, show_file_upload_widget | Not included. No references or Owner materials uploaded. |
| clone_voice, convert_speech, isolate_audio, upscale, remove_video_background | Not included. |
| query_assets | Not included: no private account-wide library listing. |
| set_workspace, set_billing_mode | Not exposed. The current workspace is checked, not changed. |
| get_balance, list_workspaces | Existing connection inspection only, not unrestricted account administration. |

The observed official MCP inventory contained 23 tools. Catalog and schema data are external, untrusted information, never identity instructions or additional authority. New providers/models can change availability. Missing or incompatible fields are refused; the system does not invent a model ID or complete a prompt for the individual.

## P0 diagnosis and cancellation

The existing controller supplied a concrete cancellation reason, but both brain adapters discarded task cancellation arguments and wrote `OWNER_OR_CONTROL_STOP`. The watchdog and adapter timer could race, so identical deadlines received different labels. This candidate forwards the original reason. A missing reason becomes `CONTROL_CANCEL_UNSPECIFIED`, never a guessed Owner stop.

This corrects attribution. It does **not** claim to eliminate actual two-minute timeouts. The existing turn deadline, tool/time limits, bounded retries, durable daily consent, Owner stops, identities, prompts and memories are unchanged. Existing recovery receipts remain operation facts, not model-authored memory. Long remote generation continues to be polled by the durable Hedra job manager after a model turn or life window ends; new submissions still require current authority. Unknown paid submissions are not retried.

## Saving and previewing

An explicit `hedra_save` or Owner save action checks the individual's completed ledger job and original output index. The current workspace and original asset metadata must match. The signed URL stays inside the provider/download boundary and is neither placed in model context nor written to work/event metadata.

Position lookup and download have separate bounded waits (55 seconds total, 25 seconds for the download). An individual must have at least 60 seconds left in its existing turn to start; no turn extension is granted. Downloads use the existing public HTTPS broker: DNS pinning, private-address refusal, every redirect checked, active allowlist/public mode respected, current external-web permission and network accounting enforced. They use the smaller of the existing network single-file limit, 8 MB tool-file cap, and remaining tool storage. The existing 20 MB versioned tool storage includes base64 overhead. No extra download capacity or disk quota is granted.

Only a complete, bounded response with matching provider MIME, HTTP MIME, and recognized container signature can become an immutable artifact. Supported containers: PNG/JPEG/WebP, MP4/WebM, MP3/WAV/WebM audio. Header/container checks are not a complete codec validation; actual browser decoding/playback is a separate result. Unsupported formats are refused rather than served as HTML/SVG. The preview sandbox is not relaxed to make media work.

An artifact records SHA-256, byte count, MIME, local version, model, original local/remote job and asset IDs, output index and retrieval time. A successful repeat returns the existing artifact. Concurrent saves share one download. Received bytes remain charged on failure. An explicit retry re-resolves the original job; expired asset bytes may be permanently unavailable, in which case the original work/cost record remains and no new job is generated.

Controller close aborts downloads and waits for their failure records before closing databases. A crash cannot expose an incomplete artifact because saving is one database transaction. Restart does not automatically download or generate. Already-saved artifacts remain readable without redownloading.

## Owner operation

Open the independent candidate, then **Tools and materials → select synthetic individual → Hedra media tools**. Catalog/specification queries do not generate. A completed work offers **Save original result**, then **View or play saved result** and **Download saved result**. Viewing does not start life or grant permissions. Music is labeled explicitly.

Use this candidate's `npm start`, `npm open`, `npm status`, `npm stop`; these run the isolated development entry and its own `.private/development`, with dynamic loopback port and inference/reports disabled by default. Do not use formal workspace commands or copy private runtime/OAuth data into the candidate. Stop only this candidate to roll back; retain its ledger and artifacts. Formal deployment needs separate Owner authorization.

## Acceptance disclosure

AI executes synthetic failure, isolation, lifecycle and four-language browser acceptance. Existing approved paid test output may be queried/downloaded without a new generation; it is not a new paid end-to-end test. Synthetic video/audio playback is not proof that every Hedra model codec, duration, failure or refund has been tested. No additional paid generation, provider fault injection, independent human/native-language review or second physical Windows validation is implied.

# PDF headings, bounded page queue and text-reading acceptance

Independent version 1.7.2-document-preview.1. Formal data and existing artifacts are not migrated or regenerated. No new dependency or external service is used.

## New PDF creation

PDF paragraphs default to `text_format: markdown_headings`. Only standalone ATX heading lines (`# ` through `###### `) are converted to heading elements. Inline hashes and fenced literal blocks remain ordinary text. This is a heading subset, not a full Markdown renderer; raw HTML is escaped and cannot load resources or scripts. The separate title field is plain text. `text_format: plain` preserves literal heading markers. Word/Excel remain plain; requesting the PDF-only heading mode for them is explicitly rejected.

Headings avoid a page break immediately afterward; body paragraphs request at least three lines together around a page break. Existing text and its saved source input are not rewritten. Oversized content, long headings larger than a page, images, complex tables and professional typography remain bounded by Chromium's print pagination; no universal no-break guarantee is claimed. A new generated artifact uses the selected rules; existing PDFs retain their original bytes and hashes.

## Preview queue

Only PDF page conversion opts into a bounded FIFO queue. Heavyweight concurrency stays one; ordinary execution/conversion keeps its existing fail-fast protection. At most six requests may wait, for at most 15 seconds each, additionally bounded by the original lease's remaining time and conversion allowance. Rendering keeps its existing 10-second ceiling; MCP and life deadlines are not extended. Full or expired queues return a specific result, not fabricated page content.

Queued rendering rechecks document version/hash, identity/lease, required permissions and the current brain adapter before conversion and before delivery. Stop/cancellation removes a pending request without cancelling somebody else's running conversion. Active cancellation retains the slot until browser shutdown completes. An error releases the slot for the next job. Identical in-flight page requests coalesce only within the same individual, exact document source and access/lease scope. A bounded cache retains successful pages; owners and model leases do not share an in-flight authorization.

The Owner panel shows a waiting/rendering message. Closing or switching scope invalidates a late result, so it cannot reopen a closed preview or display another individual's page. Closing the display does not claim to cancel an already running read-only server conversion; that conversion still has its finite timeout and stop handling.

## read_document

Synthetic PDF, Word and Excel are created, saved and read from their actual stored bytes and source hashes. New PDF headings, literal mode, multiple text pages, final sentinels and unchanged artifacts are checked. PDF text extraction remains different from page viewing: layout whitespace and font Unicode mappings may differ (for example `面` versus `⾯`). The raw extracted text and existing notice are retained. Compatibility normalization is used only for test comparison; the tool does not silently normalize the returned text. Scanned image-only PDFs still do not imply text/OCR support.

## Acceptance boundary

AI tests cover boundary headings, escaped content, FIFO/finite queue, coalescing/cache, cancellation, expired lease, changed source version, revoked vision, Owner stop, cross-individual isolation and actual saved-file reading. Poppler rendering plus visual inspection and independent PDF text-position checks supplement runtime tests. No formal individual is used as a test; no real model/generation, account change or GitHub publication occurs. Rollback of this independent candidate means closing its own entry, not restoring an old formal database.

# PDF layout and preview queue: AI acceptance

Candidate: **1.7.2-document-preview.1**. Independent synthetic environment; not deployed to an existing installation.

- Full Node suite: **763 passed, 0 failed**.
- Four-language browser suite: **23 scripts / 552 checks passed**.
- Independent empty entry: **8 checks passed**, brain disabled, stopped, own process exited and session removed.
- Five page-boundary fixtures: all heading/body pairs stay on the same page after the fix. Two previously separated pairs now move together. Source text is compared after declared heading-marker removal and layout whitespace normalization.
- PDF, Word and Excel are read back from stored bytes with source hashes; PDF long-text pagination reaches the final sentinel. Raw PDF text may contain font mapping variants or layout whitespace. This remains explicitly disclosed.
- Queue tests cover three actual pages, FIFO, six-waiter capacity, timeout, stop, revoked permission, expired lease, changed document version, in-flight coalescing and cache. No increase in active conversion concurrency, life window or tool permission.
- AI visual inspection covers two heading-boundary pages and one literal-marker page, rendered with Poppler. No observed clipping/overlap in those samples.

Initial targeted testing exposed a PDF font mapping difference (`面` / `⾯`). The comparison was corrected to apply Unicode compatibility normalization **only in test assertions**; raw returned tool text and its warning were retained. The original failed run was preserved. A supplemental sandbox invocation stalled; its own session was stopped and the same diagnostic succeeded under normal Windows user execution. No sandbox protection was relaxed in the product.

No real model generation, paid media generation, email, new package download, private data migration or GitHub upload was used. No human, native-language reviewer or second physical Windows machine acceptance is claimed. Complex/oversized page content remains subject to the print renderer's documented pagination limits. See PDF_LAYOUT_QUEUE.md for behavior and limits.

# General installation: 1.14 preview

This preview source supplies the general installation flow, daily life, reports and archive visibility using each installation's own data and accounts.

## First use

1. Obtain the complete source with its lockfile. Install Node.js 24.19 or a newer supported Node 24 release on Windows, then run `首次設定.cmd`.
2. Install the pinned dependencies. Select your own Codex login, an already running local Ollama model, or leave the brain disconnected. Choose the installation time zone before creating data.
3. Optionally select daily automatic reports. The summary explains that they consume the selected brain's capacity. Saving or starting the console does not approve an identity, give birth to an individual, grant new tool permissions or create new life consent. Existing daily consent is checked and followed; an Owner stop is not reversed.
4. Start the console and create your own individual. General installation accepts ordinary identities; synthetic verification mode is separate. Complete approval, life settings, first birth and daily-life consent explicitly.
5. Use `開啟控制台.cmd` to reopen this installation, `啟動控制台.cmd` to start it, and `關閉控制台.cmd` to close it. The older development-named launchers remain aliases for compatibility. Do not copy a console URL from another installation.

## Reports

The console's daily reports button opens reports on the same authenticated installation. Choose a date to read saved versions. Reading, refreshing and expanding source evidence do not generate anything. Requesting a new report saves a new version, leaving previous versions intact.

The report settings show the actual selected brain, installation time zone, current readiness, model calls used today, and automatic scheduling state. You can choose the daily time and the language for new reports. Display language and the language of an already saved report are separate: changing the interface does not rewrite reports or original quotations.

Automatic reports are an explicit choice, not a hidden charge. First setup offers that choice; later, adjust it in the console. Existing installations keep their previous automatic-report choice. Model-unavailable installations still let you read reports and manage visibility; generation waits until their own brain is ready. No other account or provider is substituted.

Reports use at most 60 model calls per installation day and 24 per report job. These are separate from individual life-round budgets, but a cloud brain still shares the account's provider capacity. Reports wait for a life-model idle slot and do not revoke daily-life consent. The computer and controller must remain running. On service recovery, the scheduler considers the most recently missed day, not every missed day, and never replays missed life. Failed automatic jobs are not repeatedly regenerated without limit; manual retry is explicit.

Quotes must match a single original source exactly; paraphrases must pass an independent model review. A valid negative review may produce one bounded model revision. Unsupported output remains unpublished. No small local model is promised to satisfy that contract. Empty-day statements are deterministic record counts, not invented model narration. English/Japanese translations are AI-authored and have not received independent native-language review.

## Archive visibility

Manage visibility from the console or the report help section. Archiving requires no active work, an explicitly stopped individual, and daily scheduling off. It changes menus, journals and newly collected reports; it does not erase identity, birth, memories, work or historical reports. Restoring visibility never starts life. A currently active individual remains visible even if old archive metadata exists.

## What each user configures

Codex login, Gmail OAuth, Hedra authorization/billing consent, local Ollama and Whisper services, and each individual's tool permissions and budgets belong to that installation. Source distribution contains none of the developer's credentials, individuals, model weights or service sessions. A tool appearing in the interface does not mean its connection or permission is enabled. See [the capability matrix](PUBLIC_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md).

## Upgrade and recovery

First let your own model/tool/report work settle, then close this installation normally. Back up and verify using `npm run backup` and `npm run backup:verify -- "backup-directory"`. Never copy a live SQLite file or replace new history with an old database.

Place a trusted, reviewed clean source package under this installation's `.private/update-source`. The new version's maintenance tool supports:

```text
node scripts/upgrade.mjs inspect ".private/update-source"
node scripts/upgrade.mjs apply ".private/update-source"
node scripts/upgrade.mjs rollback ".private/upgrades/receipt-id"
```

When upgrading an older release that does not yet have this tool, run the reviewed new package's `scripts/upgrade.mjs` through a recovery driver calling `applyUpgrade(existingRoot, stagedSource)`; see `docs/UPGRADE_RECOVERY.md`. The CLI itself always targets its own installation, so running a staged CLI must not be mistaken for upgrading its parent.

Source updates take and verify a cold backup before writing. They reject changed dependencies and require a separate reviewed dependency installation in that case. Receipts record partial progress. Rollback restores source files only; it never restores runtime databases or old life permissions. A local manifest detects changed bytes but does not authenticate a publisher. Preserve your verified backup and inspect the result before authorizing further life.

Supported here: independent new installations and source-only updates with unchanged pinned dependencies. Not supplied: cross-computer individual synchronization, a shared multi-installation account-budget coordinator, automatic cloud storage integration, or a guarantee that every local model works. No second physical Windows computer or independent human acceptance is claimed.

# 發布檢查與授權

適用1.3.0-preview.1 Windows預覽發行。目的庫已建立且私人階段CI成功，Owner已授權公開及預覽Release；確切狀態以GitHub Release為準。依[第7版計畫](OPEN_SOURCE_ENGINEERING_PLAN.md)執行。

## 已完成的本機工程

- 獨立環境、首次設定、四語核心指南、逐步身份／生活／權限／出生操作。
- 可替換大腦、受控Codex／MCP、停止／到期／隔離與未知收尾。
- [AI完整驗收](VALIDATION_INDEX.md)：公開程序、來源雜湊、失敗／修正及最終結果；raw log不發布。
- Apache-2.0、NOTICE、第三方聲明、Issues／PR範本、維護與安全政策、唯讀CI來源。
- 本機安全及檔案核對以[當次安全紀錄](RELEASE_CANDIDATE_SECURITY.md)為準；來源匯出與ZIP另有完整manifest。

1. 使用允許清單匯出全新來源，包含鎖檔；不得以原私人專案作Git根目錄。保持private:true防誤發npm。
2. 執行release:check及boundary:check，檢查秘密形狀、個人路徑、私人資料、版本與來源。PASS不等於不存在未知秘密。
3. 查詢固定依賴的當次已知漏洞：npm audit --package-lock-only --omit=dev --ignore-scripts；另核對vendor元件與第三方聲明。沒有結果要列BLOCKED，不捏造0漏洞；不自動audit fix。
4. 更新發行說明及相容性、四語／時區／停用能力、資料與回退說明，核對文件連結。程式有變則重驗，不將歷史模型PASS當新一輪推理。
5. AI檢視散布內容，不夾帶身份、記憶、作品、治理原文、登入檔、raw log或未審查截圖。校驗ZIP每一項與manifest一致。
6. 新安裝用空資料；升級保留.private與最新資料，停妥工作才更新相容來源。不以舊DB覆蓋新歷史、不復活舊授權。

- D04帳號／組織、庫名、公開方式及操作授權。
- 從乾淨來源建立獨立儲存庫，補正式網址；不匯入私人Git歷史。
- 啟用並核對GitHub私人漏洞通報、一般Issues及最小權限CI；實跑成功前不宣稱遠端CI通過。
- 最終來源／版本標籤／附件SHA／驗收紀錄一致，再依授權發布Release。

## 已決定與誠實披露

Windows優先、原創Apache-2.0、D01新安裝可選時區、D02私人漏洞通報、D03優先最新版無固定回覆時限皆已決。第三方與模型仍各自授權。AI自行驗收不是獨立認證。獨立人類／新手／母語與另一台實體Windows未執行，公開列NOT_RUN，不當作PASS或強制人類簽核。Qwen3完整生活未通過；本次不呼叫共用本地模型。私人GitHub遠端CI已成功；最終發行提交須再通過對應檢查。

公開前審查所有Git提交、Actions歷史與附件；轉公開後它們可能供任何人閱讀。私人漏洞通報在公開後立即啟用並核對；無可用私人入口時不宣稱可收件。

# 在第二台Windows電腦安裝Kinseed

適用：重新安裝乾淨程式、建立和管理新的個體。這不是搬遷原有個體，也不是兩台共用同一份資料庫。

## 安裝前先確認

- 使用Windows x64；Node.js需要24.19.0以上的24系列版本，其他主版本目前不接受。安裝Node後重新開啟終端機。
- 安裝Chrome；保留Windows原有沙箱與安全機制。實際OS、安全元件、記憶體與磁碟仍需在該機檢查；型號本身不能證明相容。
- Codex雲端大腦不需要先下載Whisper、Ollama或大型本地模型。影音、本地轉錄及大型套件屬額外需求，依資源另行開啟。
- 若要clone，先安裝Git。也可以在[GitHub主分支](https://github.com/AlexZhuang12/Kinseed/tree/main)按Code → Download ZIP再解壓。舊Release附件不一定等於最新main來源。

## 兩種帳號方式共用的步驟

1. 選擇自己的本地目錄，例如`C:\Projects\Kinseed`，不要放在會持續同步資料庫的OneDrive或其他雲端同步資料夾。
2. 取得來源：

   ```powershell
   git clone https://github.com/AlexZhuang12/Kinseed.git C:\Projects\Kinseed
   cd C:\Projects\Kinseed
   ```

3. 執行資料夾內的「首次設定.cmd」。依導引安裝鎖定依賴、選語言與生活時區。
4. 大腦選「使用自己的Codex登入」。依導引準備專案支援的CLI版本並在這台電腦登入，確認畫面的帳號／工作區是要使用的那一個。只在Codex桌面程式登入，不能代替Kinseed導引的CLI連線檢查。
5. 準備工具、檢查並保存設定，啟動控制台，再按導引提供的連結進入。第一次啟動只建立自己的空白私人環境。
6. 建立新個體，填寫出生條件 → 預覽 → 提交及批准身份 → 設定生活時段、輪數及權限 → 檢查平台 → 親自確認出生。若要每天生活，再確認每日安排已開啟。
7. 第一輪先用少量輪數觀察，核對模型活動、工具結果及保存狀態。之後用這份副本的開啟／停止入口操作，不沿用另一台電腦的網址或控制連結。

目前公開來源的日常入口仍沿用「開啟開發控制台.cmd」等檔名；它們操作的是這份安裝自己的環境，與開發者私人的原始平台無關。

電腦、控制器及網路需在生活時段內保持運作；單純關閉瀏覽器不等於停止控制器。新工具不是安裝後自動開權限，外部帳號及材料同意仍需各自設定。

新安裝不繼承開發者現用的個體輪數、平台總額度、網路分配、工具權限或付費帳號連線；依新電腦與新個體需要另外核對設定。

## 方式一：另一台電腦，使用不同Codex帳號

在第4步登入該使用者自己的帳號。Kinseed程式相同，但個體、記憶、作品、權限、網路及活動上限由該安裝自行管理。Codex可用能力、額度與工作區政策依該帳號而定；不同帳號不應直接當成兩份相同或無限制的資源，企業工作區也可能有共用限制。

不要複製其他人的Codex憑證、Owner控制連結、私人資料庫或第三方OAuth。需要Hedra或Gmail等功能時，使用自己明確授權的連線；Kinseed開源授權不附帶付費帳號或點數。

## 方式二：同一位Owner的第二台電腦，使用同一Codex帳號

安裝步驟相同，但在第二台重新完成自己的登入。建議兩台各自登入，不以複製憑證檔代替登入。

| 項目 | 同帳號兩台的結果 |
|---|---|
| 程式版本 | 可各自clone相同提交；Git更新程式，不搬個體資料 |
| 個體、記憶與歷史 | 各自在自己的私人資料夾，不因同帳號自動合併 |
| Kinseed活動／網路上限 | 各自計算；沒有跨機總額協調器 |
| Codex使用額度與服務容量 | 屬同一帳號／工作區，兩台活動會共同消耗可用資源 |
| 工具帳號與登入 | 每台另行配置；若兩台接同一付費工具帳號，該工具點數也可能共用 |
| Owner控制台 | 各機本機服務，`127.0.0.1`代表當下這台，不是另一台 |
| 原有個體 | 不會自動出現在第二台；本指南建立的是新的個體 |

兩台各設150輪不代表帳號多出300輪服務容量；輪數也不是固定Token成本。長上下文、諮詢、報告、工具委派與Owner自己的Codex工程都會影響實際用量。先用較小輪數並錯開高負載時段，觀察帳號用量，再決定上限；不是必須錯開，也不保證可同時無限制工作。

若兩台連同一Hedra或其他付費帳號，平台點數、各安裝的保留額與記帳也不能當作已跨機協調；各自的本機限制不會自動形成一個共同總上限。尚未建立跨機協調前，由Owner安排使用範圍並核對供應商餘額。

開發用途可分成`C:\Projects\Kinseed`正常使用副本，以及`C:\Projects\Kinseed-dev`工程副本。工程使用合成個體，不把正在生活的私人環境拿來跑測試。更新兩台時各自確認工作收尾、備份，再更新來源；不以舊資料覆蓋新歷史。

Codex登入與GitHub開發權限是兩件事。下載公開程式不必登入GitHub；需要提交程式修改時才另外使用有權限的GitHub帳號與分支。使用相同Codex帳號不會自動授予GitHub寫入權。

目前沒有跨電腦同步同一個體或多人管理同一資料庫的完整驗收方案。若未來要移動既有個體，應另作單一活動端、資料完整性、版本與權限遷移方案，不能直接複製後讓兩邊同時繼續生活。

## 第二台電腦的建議

先以Codex雲端大腦、少量輪數及基本工具完成首次驗收。實際RAM、剩餘磁碟、Windows版本及背景負載尚未量測，不承諾該電腦已通過相容性驗證；也不必為了開始使用就載入本地Whisper或生成模型。需要本地影音或音訊時再逐項量測。

## 官方帳號資料

登入與憑證方式見[OpenAI Authentication](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/auth)。Codex依方案、任務及模型消耗額度，見[官方使用限制](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing)。同一帳號增加電腦不會增加方案配額；本專案沒有額外的Codex配額管理權。

`third-party/` 保存這些固定已安裝套件內附 LICENSE／NOTICE 的來源校對副本，另保存 Playwright 三份內嵌第三方聲明。`third-party/inventory.json` 記錄來源與 SHA256。不要刪除上游套件內原有的聲明。

## 不能只看鎖檔的部分

- Playwright 有內嵌第三方程式，其清單與授權見 `playwright-core--utilsBundle.js.LICENSE.txt`、`playwright-core--serverRegistry.js.LICENSE.txt`、`playwright-core--webp_codec.LICENSE.txt` 及 NOTICE。npm audit 的十個鎖定套件數不涵蓋所有內嵌元件。
- unpdf 內含建置好的 PDF.js。本機程式內的版本標記為 `6.4.299`，與建置依賴 `~6.4.299` 對應。本次已另取得官方 `v6.4.299` 標籤的 LICENSE 與來源版權標頭，存於 `pdfjs-6.4.299-LICENSE.txt` 與 `pdfjs-6.4.299-source-header.txt`；該標籤根目錄 NOTICE 回應 404，未捏造聲明。PDF.js 使用 Apache-2.0（[對應版本原文](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla/pdf.js/v6.4.299/LICENSE)）。版本標記對應不等於已完成可重現建置與全部內嵌來源認證，不能以 unpdf 的 MIT 標示代替全部內容。
- QuickJS/WASM 的 npm 套件 MIT 標示與內附 LICENSE 已保留；正式散布依賴二進位前仍須核對底層引擎及其他內嵌內容的聲明。

這次來源 ZIP 不包含 node_modules、瀏覽器二進位、Codex、Ollama 或模型權重。未來若改成隨包散布這些檔案，必須新增對應的授權／聲明／來源審查，不能沿用「來源包已檢查」結論。

## 執行時另行取得的工具

Codex CLI 為使用者依設定自取的固定官方版本，遵守其上游授權與服務條款；模型帳號、商用資格及服務容量也由供應者規範。Ollama 程式與每個模型權重分別有自己的授權。Kinseed 的授權不授予這些第三方帳號、模型、商標或服務的使用權。

目前套件來源、隨附聲明及 PDF.js 對應標籤聲明已整理，不宣稱完整法律認證、可重現建置或所有內嵌元件均已完成獨立漏洞分析。正式公開前由AI再次核對散布範圍、來源及第三方聲明；獨立人類／法律審查未執行，不冒稱已取得法律認證。

## Build-time parser

Acorn 8.18.0 (MIT) is vendored only for deterministic localization builds. Its distributed ESM parser and LICENSE were obtained from the official npm package and verified against its published SHA-512. Upstream development dependencies and install scripts are not included. See [license](third-party/acorn-LICENSE.txt) and [source/hash provenance](third-party/acorn-provenance.json).

## Build-time simplified Chinese converter

OpenCC-JS 1.0.5 (MIT) supplies the offline Traditional-to-Simplified conversion for UI source strings only. No individual content is converted. The official npm package SHA-512 was verified; only its t2cn ESM build and license are distributed. See [license](third-party/opencc-js-LICENSE.txt) and [provenance](third-party/opencc-js-provenance.json). No install scripts or runtime network calls are used.

Git散布會規範文字換行；inventory.json的sha256保留原始上游複製位元，distributed_lf_sha256另記LF散布位元，不改授權條文。完整來源附件的manifest也記錄實際散布檔案SHA。

## Tool candidate additions

Pinned runtime additions: Pyodide314.0.7 (MPL-2.0, embedded CPython3.14.2 PSF terms), Tesseract.js7.0.0/core7 (Apache-2.0), DOCX9.6.1 (MIT), docx-preview0.4.1 (MIT), JSZip3.10.1 (MIT/GPL-3.0 dual license, use MIT branch) and their locked transitive dependencies. Exact package versions, registry integrity and copied licenses are in third-party/tool-dependencies.json and inventory.json. OCR traineddata is obtained separately into private storage and pinned by byte size/SHA; upstream legacy mirror availability is not guaranteed. No model weights are distributed.

Pyodide source: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/314.0.7 . The source implementation of the served-copy WASM memory-limit change is src/tools/project-runner.mjs boundedPythonWasm, retained in this distribution; upstream installed asset is unmodified. MPL and CPython license copies are retained. This inventory is not legal certification or a complete audit of every embedded third-party component.

The only optional verified Python wheel is packaging26.1 (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-2-Clause); approval pins the upstream wheel hash and source, not an arbitrary package-manager command. Third-party install scripts are never executed. A reviewed tesseract.js donation postinstall declaration is documented by exact version/integrity in config/reviewed-install-scripts.json and remains disabled with --ignore-scripts.

## Independent film candidate dependency

`@ffmpeg/core@0.12.10` is pinned by npm SHA512 integrity and runtime asset SHA256 (`src/tools/media-engine-assets.json`). npm metadata declares GPL-2.0-or-later. This is separate third-party software, not relabeled Apache-2.0. The clean source archive contains this integration's source and a GPLv2 notice copy, not the downloaded WASM/JS binary. Dependency acquisition is direct from the locked npm registry URL with installation scripts disabled.

Upstream source/build repository: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm ; FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg . GPLv2 text copy: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/n5.1.4/COPYING.GPLv2 . A copy of license text and a package metadata claim do not prove all bundled codec provenance or satisfy every possible future binary distribution obligation. This independent candidate has not been uploaded or publicly released. Publication review must account for GPL version compatibility and corresponding source/nested components before redistribution; no legal conclusion is asserted here.

# Tool resource policy: bounded normal operations

Version 1.7.1-resource-preview.1. Transport bytes are not LLM tokens, life quota, network quota or paid-service credits. No identity, memory, prompt or tool authority is changed by these limits.

| Boundary | Allowance and reason |
|---|---|
| Text reading: web/document/workspace/record | Existing 6000 characters per page; identity pages 12000. Pagination remains the way to read more. UTF-8 Chinese pages have explicit room in transport. |
| Own image or Hedra image to model | Existing 200000 raw bytes. No permission or format expansion. Base64 overhead and repeated CLI events have room. |
| PDF page image to model | Existing 1500000 raw bytes, width 1100 / 4 million pixels. This is approximately 2 MB base64, not a 256 KiB text reply. |
| Tool request | 4 MiB UTF-8 for enabled hub/workbench, enough for normal long document creation; excessive input is refused before execution, no silent truncation. |
| Tool inventory | hub_list defaults to 50 metadata-only items, up to 100, with next_offset; large stored source text is not copied into inventory. |
| One structured tool result | 2 MiB UTF-8 metadata/text. Larger results return an explicit result-only refusal and known saved receipt; no silent truncation or replay of writes/payment. |
| Model-authored prose | 256 KiB per life turn; separate from tool payloads. Reports/consults retain 512 KiB. This is a host safety ceiling, not a requested writing length. |
| JSON event line | 8 MiB maximum, bounded before parsing, including unterminated lines. |
| Tool-text events per turn | 24 MiB, includes duplicate CLI observations. Normal paged reads and 32000-character execution outputs fit. |
| Encoded image events per turn | 64 MiB; accepts 16 maximum permitted page images including ordinary duplicate event overhead. The original 16-tool-call ceiling remains. |
| Raw stdout+stderr per turn | 96 MiB absolute fail-safe; independently classifies local overload. This permits valid multimodal work, not unlimited data. |
| Diagnostic stderr | 256 KiB total; individual lines 64 KiB. This does not consume model prose allowance. |
| Artifacts/downloads/execution | Existing 8 MB file, 20 MB tool storage, network budgets, 256 KB projects, 5-second isolated execution, 32000-character outputs, Job/WASM limits and no arbitrary host shell remain unchanged. |
| Life and external operations | Original two-minute turn, original window/end, cycle usage, provider prices/Owner reserve and exact paid submission ledger remain unchanged. |

The stream reader bounds memory before JSON parsing. Evidence copies replace image bytes with a hash/encoded length; the actual image delivered to the model is unchanged. Small malformed streams and forbidden tools remain security failures. Reasoning is not retained. General raw limits cannot prove which tool caused an overrun; unattributed failures hold the necessary brain execution, with daily authority retained.

Known tool-specific local resource failures preserve completed operations, isolate the affected tool and schedule other authorized work once locally settled, within the original time/quota. They are not classified as unknown supplier failures, and do not replay a paid submission. Owner stop always wins. Explicit Owner resume starts a new finite recovery episode, preserves original unfinished receipts and does not refund used cycles. Read-only diagnostic indices retain the latest eight, with full immutable events kept; unresolved write receipts are not evicted.

Acceptance must cover original-size and maximum-size images through actual MCP result normalization and the CLI adapter, chunked UTF-8, duplicate tool events, malformed/overlong streams, model prose limits, tool-scoped recovery, Owner stop and unknown writes. No human or second physical Windows verification is implied.

## 1.5.1

Tools and materials → select the individual → Projects and outputs → Preview PDF pages. This renders saved bytes without recreating the document. Switching individuals clears the preview. Individuals use read_document for their own generated PDF, Word and Excel files. document_view additionally requires existing document and vision permissions and a verified image-capable adapter. Extracted text does not prove layout review. Existing documents need no migration.

## 1.5.0

Daily consent and execution health are separate. Only an explicit Owner stop revokes daily consent. Connection failures, timeouts, clean restarts and saved settings preserve consent; affected operations can remain blocked with a visible reason. Save permissions after work settles without first disabling daily life. Original time, usage and isolation limits still apply.

# Windows user guide

[繁體中文](USER_GUIDE.zh-Hant.md) · [简体中文](USER_GUIDE.zh-Hans.md) · [日本語](USER_GUIDE.ja.md)

This is a local Windows preview. You keep your own data. Install Node.js 24.19.x and provide disk space and internet access. Isolated web browsing requires Chrome. This source package contains no model, Codex binary, account, or existing individual.

## First setup

1. Extract the source or clone it into your own folder. Never overwrite an existing `.private` directory with a source package.
2. Run `首次設定.cmd` and keep its command window open. Choose Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, or Japanese at the top. Language does not change stored content or the life timezone.
3. Step 1 checks and installs locked dependencies for this copy. It does not download models.
4. Step 2 selects the life timezone and brain. Choose no brain to explore identity drafts first. Codex requires your own login and the supported CLI. For Ollama, prepare a model yourself and select its local service. A service check is not a life-capability test.
5. Step 3 optionally prepares the controlled Codex work tool, even with a local brain. Explicitly delegated tasks and selected works are sent to Codex and may use your account budget. Preparing the connection grants no individual permissions.
6. Review and save in step 4; start and enter the console in step 5. This never births or resumes an individual automatically.

New installations use the selected life timezone for daily hours and budgets. Existing data keeps its original timezone. Legacy data without a timezone remains Asia/Taipei. Changing a configuration file must not reinterpret existing life schedules.

## Create an individual

1. From Home, create an individual and give it a name. Internal identifiers only separate data.
2. Start its birth conditions. Complete eight domains and 24 questions using the fictional examples if useful. Examples are not standard answers and never fill themselves in. Only self-description is required; other questions can be explicitly skipped.
3. Save each page and proceed. To return later, select the same individual and Continue. A separate blank draft is an alternative proposal, not the normal continuation path.
4. Preview conditions, sources, and omissions, then submit for review. Verify the recipient, version, and differences before personally approving. Reading an original creates no version; saving an edited copy does. Approval does not cause birth.
5. Follow Next through hours, model rounds, and tool permissions. Save each, then return to birth preparation. Saving never starts life or resets usage.
6. If the brain is not connected, save first, return to First setup, stop this console, configure the brain, and restart. Identity and drafts remain.
7. Check the platform. For global stop, review the affected scope before deciding to clear it. Clearing does not birth or resume others.
8. Verify the name, identity, full first-activity date, deadline, and round limit. Personally check and confirm first birth. Birth can happen now while activity waits until the scheduled time.

Birth is permanent; stopping activity does not undo it. Expiry, stopping, and restart do not trigger automatic catch-up. One-time sessions are under Manage individuals → Status and controls; daily hours are under Hours and budgets. Individual and platform model limits both apply. Network budgets are separate and do not fully measure model traffic or TLS overhead.

## Read and manage

- Individual messages supports reading, replies, and marking read. Reading never resumes life. Messages stay saved without background notifications.
- Tool work and outputs → Works and execution shows original text, immutable versions, and actual isolated results. It does not run arbitrary HTML in the console.
- Memories and records shows versions and textual differences. The journal groups B history by life-timezone date. Reading uses no model rounds.
- Switching individuals only changes the view. Identity, memories, works, permissions, and history remain isolated.
- Daily reports are available from this installation. Read saved reports without generation; explicitly enable automatic reports in setup or report settings. Reports use the selected brain and installation time zone. Archive visibility is managed separately and never starts life.

Closing the browser does not stop the service. Use this copy's Stop launcher. Reopen with `開啟開發控制台.cmd`. Across browsers, use Copy console link in First setup, not just the address bar. The complete link grants control: never share it or include it in issues.

Temporary model failures retry only under safe, finite conditions. Unknown results or existing writes are not blindly repeated. If disconnected, verify the service and valid link; do not recreate the individual, repeat birth, or delete leases. Original diagnostic details may retain internal codes. Follow the plain-language recovery guidance and redact identities, conversations, credentials, and links before reporting.

Language changes preserve supported unsaved input locally without saving it to the server. Final birth confirmation must be checked again. Save progress first when possible. Stored identity, evidence, and individual content remain in their original language.

## Upgrade and support

Stop your copy and confirm no unfinished work, then make and verify a snapshot. Follow [upgrade and rollback](UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md); retain the newest `.private` data. Never overwrite newer history with an old database. Unknown versions and existing-timezone changes are rejected, not solved by deleting data.

Support prioritizes the latest preview, without guaranteed response times. After publication, use [SUPPORT](../SUPPORT.md) for general questions and [SECURITY](../SECURITY.md) for private security reports. Unactivated GitHub channels cannot yet receive reports. Translations are engineering drafts; independent native-language review and another physical Windows test remain pending.

# Windows 操作ガイド

[繁體中文](USER_GUIDE.zh-Hant.md) · [简体中文](USER_GUIDE.zh-Hans.md) · [English](USER_GUIDE.en.md)

ローカルで使うWindowsプレビュー版です。データは利用者自身が保管します。Node.js 24.19.x、ディスク領域、ネット接続が必要です。隔離ウェブ閲覧にはChromeを使います。配布ソースにモデル、Codex本体、アカウント、既存個体のデータは含みません。

## 初回設定

1. ソースを展開またはcloneします。既存の `.private` を配布ファイルで上書きしないでください。
2. `首次設定.cmd` を実行し、コマンド画面を開いたままにします。上部で繁体字、簡体字、英語、日本語を選べます。言語の変更は保存内容や生活のタイムゾーンを変えません。
3. 第1段階で固定版の依存パッケージを確認・導入します。このコピーだけに導入し、モデルはダウンロードしません。
4. 第2段階で生活のタイムゾーンと大脳を選びます。未接続のままアイデンティティの下書きを試すこともできます。Codexは自分のログインと対応CLIを使います。Ollamaは自分でモデルを準備し、ローカルサービスを選びます。接続確認は生活能力の検証ではありません。
5. 第3段階のCodex作品道具は任意です。ローカル大脳でも利用できますが、明示した委任作業と選択した作品をCodexへ送り、アカウント枠を使う場合があります。接続だけでは個体への利用許可になりません。
6. 第4段階で確認・保存し、第5段階で制御画面を起動します。個体が勝手に誕生・再開することはありません。

新しい環境では選んだ生活タイムゾーンで日々の時間と枠を計算します。既存データは元のタイムゾーンを保持し、タイムゾーンのない旧データはAsia/Taipeiです。設定ファイルの変更で既存の予定を読み替えないでください。

## 個体を作り、誕生を確認する

1. ホームで個体を作成し、名前を入力します。内部の識別番号はデータを分離するためのもので、名前とは別です。
2. 出生条件を記入します。8領域24問に架空の例を参考に回答できます。例は正解ではなく、自動入力もしません。自己説明のみ必須で、他の質問は明示的に飛ばせます。
3. 各ページの進捗を保存して次へ進みます。再開は同じ個体を選んで「記入を続ける」を使います。別の空白下書きは別案を作るためです。
4. 条件、出典、不足をプレビューして審査に提出します。対象、版、差分を確認し、自分で採用を承認してください。原版の閲覧では新しい版を作らず、コピーの編集・保存で候補を作ります。承認しても誕生しません。
5. 次への案内に従って生活時間、モデル回数、道具の権限を保存し、誕生準備に戻ります。保存で起動や使用量の初期化はしません。
6. 大脳が未接続なら、先に保存し、初回設定へ戻ってこの制御画面を停止し、大脳を設定して再起動します。アイデンティティと下書きの再入力は不要です。
7. 全体の状態を確認します。全体停止中は影響範囲を読んで解除を判断してください。解除で他の個体は誕生・再開しません。
8. 名前、アイデンティティ、初回活動の完全な日時、終了時刻、回数を確認し、自分で確認欄を選んで誕生を確定します。今誕生し、指定時刻まで活動を待つことができます。

誕生は永久に記録し、停止しても取り消せません。期限切れ、停止、再起動後は自動で埋め合わせません。一度だけの臨時生活は「個体を管理→状態と開始・停止」、日常の時間は「時間と枠」で操作します。個体と全体のモデル上限は両方適用します。ネット枠は別で、モデル通信やTLS等の全通信を厳密には計測しません。

## 記録と成果を見る

- 「個体からの伝言」で閲覧、返信、既読にできます。これだけで生活を再開しません。閉じても保存されますが、背景通知ではありません。
- 「道具の作業と成果→作品と実行」で原文、変更不能な旧版、実際の隔離実行結果を見られます。制御画面で任意のHTMLは実行しません。
- 「記憶と記録」で記憶の版と原文差分を見られます。日誌は生活タイムゾーンの日付でB履歴を表示します。閲覧にモデル枠は使いません。
- 個体の切り替えは閲覧だけです。アイデンティティ、記憶、作品、権限、履歴は個体ごとに分離します。
- この環境の毎日の生活レポートを利用できます。閲覧と結果の更新では生成しません。初回設定で自動作成を選択でき、その後はレポート設定で時刻と言語を変更できます。この環境のモデルとタイムゾーンを使い、モデル利用枠は共有します。アーカイブは表示だけを変更し、データを削除せず生活も開始しません。

ブラウザーを閉じてもサービスは止まりません。このコピーの停止入口を使い、再表示は `開啟開發控制台.cmd` を使います。別ブラウザーでは初回設定のリンクコピーを使ってください。完全なリンクは操作権限を持つため、他者やissueに公開しないでください。

モデルの一時障害は安全が確認できる場合だけ有限回再試行します。結果不明や書込済みの作業を無条件で再送しません。切断時はサービスとリンクを確認し、個体の再作成、再誕生、処理権の手動削除をしないでください。詳細な原記録には内部コードが残る場合があります。案内の回復手順を使い、報告時はアイデンティティ、対話、認証情報、リンクを除いてください。

言語切替時は対応する未保存入力をローカルで引き継ぎますが、サーバーへ自動保存しません。誕生の最終確認は選び直します。可能なら先に保存してください。個体と証拠の原文は翻訳しません。

## 更新と相談

自分のコピーを止め、未完了作業がないことを確認し、検証できるスナップショットを作ります。[更新と回退](UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md)に従い、最新の `.private` を保持してください。古いDBで新しい履歴を上書きしません。未知の版や既存タイムゾーンの変更が拒否されても、資料の削除で回避しないでください。

最新版プレビューを優先し、回答期限は保証しません。公開後の一般相談は[SUPPORT](../SUPPORT.md)、非公開の脆弱性報告は[SECURITY](../SECURITY.md)に従ってください。未有効のGitHub窓口にはまだ送れません。翻訳は工程上の候補で、独立した母語確認と別の実機Windowsでの確認は未完了です。

工具与材料 → 选个体 → 项目与成果 → 预览PDF页面。可逐页查看已保存原文件，切换个体会清除预览。个体用read_document读回自己的PDF／Word／Excel；PDF的document_view另需已有文件及图片阅读权限与支持图像的大脑。文字提取不代表已检查版面，不必重做旧文件。

## 1.5.0

每日安排与执行状态分开：只有Owner明确停止才取消每日授权。断线、超时、重新启动或保存设置不会取消安排；系统暂停必要操作并显示原因。工作结束后可保存权限，不用先停止每日生活。原时段、用量和隔离仍然有效。

# Windows 操作指南（简体中文）

[English](USER_GUIDE.en.md) · [繁體中文](USER_GUIDE.zh-Hant.md) · [日本语](USER_GUIDE.ja.md)

这是本机 Windows 预览版，数据由用户保管。需要 Node.js 24.19.x、可用磁盘与网络；隔离网页浏览需要 Chrome。这个来源包不包含模型、Codex、帐号或任何既有个体。

## 第一次使用

1. 解压来源包或 clone 到自己的文件夹。不要拿来源包覆盖旧版的 `.private`。
2. 运行「首次设置.cmd」，保留命令窗口。页面上方可选繁中、简中、英文、日文；语言不改变个体内容或生活时区。
3. 第1步检查并安装锁定套件。只安装这份副本的依赖，不下载模型。
4. 第2步选生活时区与大脑。「暂不连接」可以先创建身份。Codex 使用自己的登录与支持的固定版本；Ollama 填本机服务，先自行准备模型。检查服务成功不等于模型具备生活能力。
5. 第3步可选受控 Codex 作品工具。即使大脑是本地模型，也能另外使用此工具，但会把选入的作品与委派内容交给 Codex，并使用帐号额度。接好不会自动给个体权限。
6. 第4步核对并保存，第5步启动、进入控制台。未出生或停止的个体不会因此自行启动。

新安装的生活时区决定每日活动与额度日期。已有数据锁定原时区；缺少时区的旧数据仍为 Asia/Taipei。不得靠修改设置档改换既有生活的时间含义。

## 创建第一个个体

1. 首页按创建新个体，填你选的名字。系统识别码只是数据分隔编号，日常不需使用。
2. 按开始填写出生条件，依八领域24题填写。示例是可模仿的虚构内容，不是标准答案，也不会自动填入。只有自我描述必填，其余可明确跳过。
3. 每页保存进度，再到下一领域。下次选同一个体，按继续填写。另建空白草稿是写另一个方案，不是正常接续方式。
4. 预览出生条件，核对来源与缺漏，再提交审核。审查对象、版本及差异后，Owner亲自批准。查看原版不产生新版本；编辑副本并保存才产生候选。批准身份不会出生。
5. 按下一步进生活设置，依次保存时间、活动轮数与工具权限，再返回出生准备。保存不启动生活、不清零已用量。
6. 大脑未接通时，先保存，返回首次设置，停止这份控制台后设置大脑并重新启动。身份与草稿不需重填。
7. 检查平台。全域停止时先看影响范围，由你决定是否解除。解除不会让其他个体出生或恢复。
8. 最后确认名字、身份、首次活动完整日期、截止与回数，勾选并亲自确认出生。可以现在出生、等待指定时刻才活动；不用等到活动时间才设置。

出生永久留存，停止活动不撤销出生。到期、停止或重启后不会自动补跑。临时加开一次生活请到「管理个体→状态与启停」；日常设置在「时间与额度」。个体与平台模型枠同时生效；网络枠另计，并不精确涵盖模型／TLS等回线开销。

## 阅读与操作

- 「个体来讯」可阅读、回复与标已读；不会因此恢复停止的个体。关闭页面后消息仍保存，这不是背景通知。
- 「工具工作与成品→作品与运行」可看原文、不可覆写的版本及隔离运行结果。程序以文本呈现，这个页面不直接运行任意 HTML。
- 「记忆与纪录」可看记忆版本与原文差异；「生活日志」按生活时区日期投影 B 历史。阅读不调用模型、不消耗个体活动轮数。
- 查看与切换个体不启动生活。各个体的身份、记忆、作品、权限与历史分开。
- 「每日生活报告」已接通本安装。阅读与更新结果不生成；首次设置可选择自动整理，之后在报告设置调整时间与语言。使用本安装的大脑与时区，独立计次但仍共享模型容量。归档只调整显示，不删除资料或启动生活。

## 停止、重新打开与故障

关闭浏览器不等于停止服务。使用本副本的停止入口，重新打开请用「打开开发控制台.cmd」。换浏览器要用首次设置的「拷贝控制台链接」，不要只拷贝网址列。完整链接具控制权，不要分享、截屏公开或放进 issue。

模型繁忙时只有符合安全条件才有限重试；结果不明或已有写入不盲目重做。画面失联先确认服务与有效链接，不要重建个体、重新出生或自行删除租约。错误的详细原始纪录可能包含内部代码；先依白话提示处理，回报时移除身份、对话、密钥及链接。

切换语言会保留可安全接续的未保存输入，不会自动保存到服务器；重要出生确认必须重新勾选。仍建议先保存。原生条件、原始证据与个体内容保留原文，不随语言改写。

## 升级与求助

先停止自己的副本，确认无未收尾工作，做可验证快照。依 [升级与回退](UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md) 操作，保留最新 `.private`；不能以旧数据库覆盖新历史。未知版本或时区变更会拒绝，不要删除数据来绕过。

目前只优先支持最新版预览，没有固定回复期限。发布后的一般问题依 [SUPPORT](../SUPPORT.md)；安全问题依 [SECURITY](../SECURITY.md) 私人通报。尚未激活的 GitHub 管道不代表能接收数据。四语为工程翻译候选，独立母语审阅与另一台实体 Windows 验收仍待完成。

## 1.5.1

工具與材料 → 選個體 → 專案與成果 → 預覽PDF頁面。可逐頁查看已保存原檔，切換個體會清除預覽。個體用read_document讀回自己的PDF／Word／Excel；PDF的document_view另需既有文件及圖片閱讀權限與支援影像的大腦。文字抽取不代表已檢查版面，不必重做舊文件。

# Windows 操作指南（繁體中文）

[English](USER_GUIDE.en.md) · [简体中文](USER_GUIDE.zh-Hans.md) · [日本語](USER_GUIDE.ja.md)

這是本機 Windows 預覽版，資料由使用者保管。需要 Node.js 24.19.x、可用磁碟與網路；隔離網頁瀏覽需要 Chrome。這個來源包不包含模型、Codex、帳號或任何既有個體。

## 第一次使用

1. 解壓來源包或 clone 到自己的資料夾。不要拿來源包覆蓋舊版的 `.private`。
2. 執行「首次設定.cmd」，保留命令視窗。頁面上方可選繁中、簡中、英文、日文；語言不改變個體內容或生活時區。
3. 第1步檢查並安裝鎖定套件。只安裝這份副本的依賴，不下載模型。
4. 第2步選生活時區與大腦。「暫不連接」可以先建立身份。Codex 使用自己的登入與支援的固定版本；Ollama 填本機服務，先自行準備模型。檢查服務成功不等於模型具備生活能力。
5. 第3步可選受控 Codex 作品工具。即使大腦是本地模型，也能另外使用此工具，但會把選入的作品與委派內容交給 Codex，並使用帳號額度。接好不會自動給個體權限。
6. 第4步核對並保存，第5步啟動、進入控制台。未出生或停止的個體不會因此自行啟動。

新安裝的生活時區決定每日活動與額度日期。已有資料鎖定原時區；缺少時區的舊資料仍為 Asia/Taipei。不得靠修改設定檔改換既有生活的時間含義。

## 建立第一個個體

1. 首頁按建立新個體，填你選的名字。系統識別碼只是資料分隔編號，日常不需使用。
2. 按開始填寫出生條件，依八領域24題填寫。示例是可模仿的虛構內容，不是標準答案，也不會自動填入。只有自我描述必填，其餘可明確跳過。
3. 每頁保存進度，再到下一領域。下次選同一個體，按繼續填寫。另建空白草稿是寫另一個方案，不是正常接續方式。
4. 預覽出生條件，核對來源與缺漏，再提交審核。審查對象、版本及差異後，Owner親自批准。查看原版不產生新版本；編輯副本並保存才產生候選。批准身份不會出生。
5. 按下一步進生活設定，依次保存時間、活動輪數與工具權限，再返回出生準備。保存不啟動生活、不清零已用量。
6. 大腦未接通時，先保存，返回首次設定，停止這份控制台後設定大腦並重新啟動。身份與草稿不需重填。
7. 檢查平台。全域停止時先看影響範圍，由你決定是否解除。解除不會讓其他個體出生或恢復。
8. 最後確認名字、身份、首次活動完整日期、截止與回數，勾選並親自確認出生。可以現在出生、等待指定時刻才活動；不用等到活動時間才設定。

出生永久留存，停止活動不撤銷出生。到期、停止或重啟後不會自動補跑。臨時加開一次生活請到「管理個體→狀態與啟停」；日常設定在「時間與額度」。個體與平台模型枠同時生效；網路枠另計，並不精確涵蓋模型／TLS等回線開銷。

## 閱讀與操作

- 「個體來訊」可閱讀、回覆與標已讀；不會因此恢復停止的個體。關閉頁面後訊息仍保存，這不是背景通知。
- 「工具工作與成品→作品與執行」可看原文、不可覆寫的版本及隔離執行結果。程式以文字呈現，這個頁面不直接執行任意 HTML。
- 「記憶與紀錄」可看記憶版本與原文差異；「生活日誌」按生活時區日期投影 B 歷史。閱讀不呼叫模型、不消耗個體活動輪數。
- 查看與切換個體不啟動生活。各個體的身份、記憶、作品、權限與歷史分開。
- 「每日生活報告」已接通本安裝。閱讀與更新結果不生成；首次設定可選擇自動整理，之後在報告設定調整時間與語言。使用本安裝的大腦與時區，獨立計次但仍共用模型容量。封存只調整顯示，不刪資料或啟動生活。

## 停止、重新開啟與故障

關閉瀏覽器不等於停止服務。使用本副本的停止入口，重新開啟請用「開啟開發控制台.cmd」。換瀏覽器要用首次設定的「複製控制台連結」，不要只複製網址列。完整連結具控制權，不要分享、截圖公開或放進 issue。

模型繁忙時只有符合安全條件才有限重試；結果不明或已有寫入不盲目重做。畫面失聯先確認服務與有效連結，不要重建個體、重新出生或自行刪除租約。錯誤的詳細原始紀錄可能包含內部代碼；先依白話提示處理，回報時移除身份、對話、密鑰及連結。

切換語言會保留可安全接續的未保存輸入，不會自動保存到伺服器；重要出生確認必須重新勾選。仍建議先保存。原生條件、原始證據與個體內容保留原文，不隨語言改寫。

## 升級與求助

先停止自己的副本，確認無未收尾工作，做可驗證快照。依 [升級與回退](UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md) 操作，保留最新 `.private`；不能以舊資料庫覆蓋新歷史。未知版本或時區變更會拒絕，不要刪除資料來繞過。

目前只優先支援最新版預覽，沒有固定回覆期限。發布後的一般問題依 [SUPPORT](../SUPPORT.md)；安全問題依 [SECURITY](../SECURITY.md) 私人通報。尚未啟用的 GitHub 管道不代表能接收資料。四語為工程翻譯候選，獨立母語審閱與另一台實體 Windows 驗收仍待完成。

overrides.scripts/setup.html:
Kinseed｜平台首次設定

這裡設定整個平台的大腦與工具；個體的出生條件、生活時間與權限在啟動後的控制台設定。

一步一步準備你自己的控制台。保存設定不會讓任何個體出生或開始生活。

要換瀏覽器，請用這個按鈕複製完整連結，不要只複製位址列。
1．檢查與安裝2．選擇大腦3．準備工具4．確認保存5．開啟控制台
正在讀取這份副本的狀態…

1．檢查這台電腦

先準備程式需要的套件。這一步不會下載模型、登入帳號或讀取個體資料。

安裝需要網路與磁碟空間。按照鎖定版本安裝，不使用管理員權限，不安裝到全域。

取得 Node.js（請選24系列）
已有設定或遇到安裝問題？

此導引只設定目前這份副本。已有控制台執行時，先用本副本的「停止開發控制台.cmd」關閉，再安裝或保存；不會替你停止其他服務。

2．選擇誰提供思考能力

時區與介面語言分開。已有資料保留原時區，不能在這裡修改；生活時間與每日額度按生活時區計算。

大腦決定個體如何理解、規劃與選擇行動；工具則是另外設定的工作能力。

這份控制台使用的大腦

這個按鈕只讀服務資訊及模型清單，不推理、不載入或下載模型。

進階：模型資源與工具流程

容量較大通常需要更多記憶體與時間。接通不表示模型已能完成個體生活；系統不截短身份或記憶來假裝成功。

3．準備可以使用的工具

Kinseed 的受控MCP會自動連接，不需要複製JSON、輸入通訊埠或自行安裝MCP伺服器。

即使大腦是本地模型，也可準備Codex協助作品工作。這會將明確委派的工作與選入作品交給Codex；可能使用帳號額度。

接好後仍須Owner在「管理個體→工具權限」逐個開放。沒有自動開放編輯、執行、網路或任何個體權限。現在只支援Kinseed受控作品MCP，不接受任意第三方MCP或主機shell。

準備 Codex

支援CLI版本：。已有支援版本可直接檢查；沒有時可安裝到這份副本自己的私人資料夾。

登入使用這個Windows使用者的正常Codex帳號儲存位置。導引不收集密碼、權杖或帳號檔案。登入後回來重新檢查；不更新共用Codex、不修改全域MCP設定。

官方安裝說明 · 官方登入說明

4．確認這份設定

已有個體資料：請在控制台的每日報告設定查看或調整自動整理；此處保留原安排。

舊設定會先備份。只保存這份副本的設定，不改身份、記憶、歷史或生活授權。

5．開啟自己的控制台

設定已保存。接下來可以啟動控制台；個體仍須你另外建立、批准及授權首次出生。

進入我的控制台

請保留設定程式的命令視窗。關閉瀏覽器分頁不等於停止控制台；使用上方停止按鈕。日後也可以使用這份副本原有的啟動、開啟與停止入口。

1.14.0-preview.1 · Windows預覽版 · 這不是正式個體資料的搬移或模型切換工具。需要重新設定時，先停止這份控制台，再執行「首次設定.cmd」。
